title: Freelancer Scope-Reply Pack: 24 Client Replies for Scope Creep, Change Order Template and Calculator, Excel and Google Sheets
description:
"Can you just add one more…?" Answer calmly, and get the extra paid. Freelancer Scope-Reply Pack gives you a ready reply for the 8 moments that quietly turn into free work.

What it does for you:
• 24 replies: 8 moments, each with 3 moves (Price it, Swap it, Park it)
• Price it: say yes with a price and a date, never a flat no
• Swap it: keep the budget and the deadline by trading something not started
• Park it: protect this phase and quote the idea for the next one
• Change-Order Calculator: hours or flat fees, rush fee and tax on one printable page
• Reply Library: your client's name, your rate and the total fill into every reply
• Change Log: every request, your move, quotes waiting and money earned
• 10 contract lines that stop scope creep before the project starts

What's in the download:
• A 7-page PDF: the method, all 24 replies, a printable change order and the contract checklist
• 2 spreadsheets: Sample (made-up client) and Blank
• A plain-text file of all 24 replies, ready to paste into email, Slack or DMs

Good to know:
• Works in Microsoft 365, Excel 2019 or newer and Google Sheets
• Any currency and any kind of service work: design, writing, development, photography, consulting
• General information, not legal advice
• Made with AI assistance, then built and checked by hand
• Digital download, nothing ships

From Fully Funded, a Steadfold studio.
General education only, not financial advice.
